title: Beginner Ballet Class | Step-by-Step Barre 🩰 Classical Music

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher demonstrates exercises gracefully at the barre while providing calm, clear instructions. She breaks down combinations step-by-step before executing them with music.
cues: Keep length in both sides of the waist
Keep the supporting leg strong and stable

steps_taught.name: demi-plie
steps_taught.description: Half bend of the knees keeping heels on the floor

steps_taught.name: grand plie
steps_taught.description: Full bend of the knees allowing heels to lift in certain positions

steps_taught.name: tendu
steps_taught.description: Stretching the foot along the floor to a pointed position

steps_taught.name: port de bras
steps_taught.description: Carriage of the arms and torso bending

what_hinders: Lack of spoken counting during some exercises

quotes.text: I'm happy to see you in my ballet class.
First, we will learn the combination step by step, and then we will do it with music.
